physical: No physical operation can make an independent copy of an arbitrary unknown quantum state.
reflected_sentence: The prohibition on independently duplicating what is unknown keeps its shape.
rule_reason: A limit turns only when caused by resistance; this relation supplies no such cost or separation, so it keeps. Quantum states and copying have no frozen partners.
closing: The rule decides keeps without inferring resistance from the mere existence of a prohibition. Turning this into unrestricted copying would exceed the stated rule. The interpretation is empty because the frozen vocabulary cannot express the necessary objects and operation.
